newsitem.title: UK: Racal Electronics gets new radar contracts.
newsitem.headline: Racal Electronics gets new radar contracts.

text.p: Britain's Racal Electronics Plc said on Thursday it expected the order book for its Defence Radar and Avionics Group to reach over 350 million stg by this financial year-end.
Racal said it received contracts for the Searchwater 2000 radar upgrade programmes for the Replacement Maritime Patrol Aircraft (RMPA) and the Royal Navy Sea King.
The size of the contracts were not disclosed.
Racal's shares rose 6.0p to 295 by 1125 GMT.
Racal said the two contracts, together with previous orders, took the total value of radar contracts won by it to more than 200 million stg in the last six months.
The firm said that when it bought Thorn Sensors division in 1995, it targeted an order intake from the combined businesses of 250 million stg per year, for the next three years.

"The contracts confirm Racal's predictions that the order book value for its Defence Radar and Avionics Group by this financial year end will amount to more than 350 million stg," Racal said in a statement.
